description: Every simulant profile a fresh save offers, in one offline Combat match (the Simulants row of the multiplayer week status table). --debug-bot-spec gives the 15 --launch-mp-room simulants: MeatSim, EasySim, NormalSim, PeaceSim, ShieldSim, RocketSim, KazeSim, FistSim, PreySim, CowardSim, JudgeSim, FeudSim, SpeedSim, TurtleSim, VengeSim. The base bot profiles are the general type in six difficulties and twelve special types that exist only at Normal; Hard, Perfect and Dark are unlocked by challenges, so a fresh save offers these 15. Requires each simulant to be added with its traits and spawned with them (SIMULANT: allocating logs type and difficulty), a 60 s match to its time limit, the end screen and a result for all 16 participants, with no crash and no refused profile.

input_sequence.comment: Boot, seed the Combat Simulator config for this scenario, and fire the direct debug match start.
Bounded exit after stage load, a 60 second match and the end screen.
